name: Day
description: The female speaker of the poem, a woman who works only while it is light and loves Night.

description_citations.work: Love Song of Night and Day
description_citations.text: "Love Song of Night and Day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The lovers invite each other to a festival and trade stories, promises and gifts before their parting.
timeline.quote: Run with me to the festival, where we will dance until sunrise.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Day declares they will eat a farewell feast, marking the coming separation.
timeline.quote: Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On their last day together the lovers walk across the Daraja Plains, seeing everything as children.
timeline.quote: On this our last day together, let us walk across the grasslands.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Day recalls herding sheep with Night as children and his stories at evening.
timeline.quote: Even then my heart was yours.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Night remembers Day's sacred rites, from which she returned a warrior with a tattooed eye.
timeline.quote: You went in a girl, but you returned a warrior.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Day announces she must leave tomorrow to war, promising to return and telling Night to wait for her.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow I must go, my love.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Day tells of Day and Night, who glimpse each other only at dawn and dusk and whose tears wash Jamuraa red.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Night wrapped Day in his cloak and the two became as One, until Night was pulled away by the western horizon.
timeline.quote: In their miraculous embrace, the two became as One.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Day concludes that they must live apart, only glimpsing each other across the sky, because neither can change.
timeline.quote: I'll live my life apart from you, just glimpsing you across the sky

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Day loves Night, who works in darkness
